meta.subject: History
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary Second Year History, Revised Edition 2025, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 13: rise of imperialism, scramble for colonies, alliance politics and international crises, World War I, Russian Revolution, League of Nations, Great Depression, Fascism and Nazism.
meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded in the supplied 2025 textbook. Activity, project, classroom-procedure and non-examinable prompts are excluded. Direct recall is reinforced with statement-analysis questions.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page; Tamil page numbering differs and is not inferred.
